chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, raising it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The one who eats a quince upon the empty stomach would make good his water and improve the child birth.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and physical benefits of eating quince according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the consumption of quince (*safarjal*) on an empty stomach to both physiological purification and reproductive vitality. This reflects the Shia tradition of *al-tibb al-nabawi* (Prophetic medicine), where specific foods are believed to balance the body's humors, thereby enhancing the quality of offspring and bodily fluids.
